thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Usage telemetry mismatch detected for tenant-summaries (aggregation service). PagerDuty: P0 - potential billing impact. Incident ID: INC-2026-0315-01. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-0315-01

sophia: ack — i'm on call and looking. paging @miguel for infra help.

miguel: on it. seeing spike in write-event queue to usage-collector-2. possible double-counting from replays. collecting logs now.

lee: what's the customer impact? do invoices show wrong numbers yet or just UI?

miguel: initial investigation: data pipeline emitted duplicate deltas between 03:02-03:10 UTC. Billing-run hasn't executed for affected accounts (next run 04:00 UTC) but dashboard shows inflated usage. so UI-only for now but risk of billing if not mitigated.

eva: agree we need status page + customer comms that are careful about not implying incorrect billing until confirmed. drafting now.

support: drafting a minimal customer notification for customers who viewed the dashboard. propose: (see template below).

support: template and page draft below:

```Subject: Notice: Temporary usage display discrepancy
Hi <customer name>,

We detected a temporary discrepancy in the Usage dashboard between 03:02–03:10 UTC that may have caused higher usage numbers to be displayed. Our billing system has not billed based on the erroneous values. We're investigating and will post updates on status.redwood.com. If you need immediate assistance or an account review, reply to this message.

— Redwood Support
```

sophia: +1. status page proposal:

```We are investigating an issue affecting usage metrics in the dashboard for a subset of customers (03:02-03:10 UTC). No invoices have been processed with the incorrect values. We will provide updates and any required credits after reconciliation.
```

miguel: mitigation in progress: restarting usage-collector worker group for partition-7 and forcing de-dup pass on the batcher. command:

```bash
kubectl rollout restart deployment/usage-collector -n prod --field-selector='metadata.name=usage-collector-7'
# then trigger dedupe job
kubectl exec -it job/dedupe-2026-0315 -n prod -- /app/bin/dedupe --partition=7
```

sam: i'm taking over on-call at 03:18 UTC — handoff: restarted worker, dedupe job started, initial diffs show 0.3% of total tokens were duplicates but concentrated in 12 accounts. i'm paging finance for credit plan.

finance: pinged. if dedupe confirms overcharge potential we'll prepare retroactive credits and a customer outreach package. estimated effort: ~2 hours.

product: need to coordinate messaging: avoid saying 'overcharged' until recon complete. include link to support request template for customers who want account-level review.

support: adding account-level opt-in link and quick triage playbook. playbook snippet:

```1) Confirm account ID and timeframe
2) Run reconciliation script: /scripts/recon_usage.sh --account $ID --start 2026-03-15T03:02Z --end 2026-03-15T03:10Z
3) If delta > 0.5% or delta tokens > 10k -> escalate to finance
```

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0315-01 status: Mitigating — dedupe job running. Next update in 15m.

eva: ready to publish status page and send the customer notice for 'viewers' list. who owns the send? support or comms?

support: support will send the first tranche to customers who viewed the affected metrics. comms will own broader announcement when recon done.

lee: logging action items: 1) Confirm if invoice run at 04:00 includes bad data (miguel) 2) Finance prepare credits if needed (finance) 3) Support send notice to viewers (support) 4) Post final status and postmortem (sophia)

miguel: invoice-run check — billing job is separate and reads from ledger-v2 which hasn't been updated by the duped deltas because ledger write path uses idempotency key. initial checks show ledger was protected. will confirm in 10m.

finance: if ledger was protected, credits likely unnecessary, but we'll keep standing by. prepping reconciliation script and credit template.

sophia: update: ledger confirmed protected. dashboard cache corrected after dedupe. affected displays reverted to correct values. no invoices affected. closing incident in 30m pending postmortem.

support: sent customer notice to ~850 accounts who viewed affected dashboards. copy of sent message attached (snippet):

```We detected a temporary display discrepancy in your usage dashboard between 03:02–03:10 UTC. We have corrected the display and confirmed billing is unaffected. If you'd like a detailed reconciliation for your account, reply and we'll run a check.
```

sam: handing back to sophia for postmortem. also created follow-ups: add idempotency enforcement to ingestion path and add monitor alert for duplicate deltas >0.05%.

sophia: thanks all. postmortem template below — support/product/finance owners please add notes:

```- Summary: duplicate deltas displayed in usage UI due to replayed events in ingestion path.
- Impact: inaccurate dashboard displays for ~850 accounts between 03:02–03:10 UTC. No billing impact.
- Root cause: lack of strict idempotency check on consumer retry path.
- Mitigations: restarted worker group, dedupe pass, cache invalidation.
- Follow ups: add idempotency key enforcement, add monitor alert, run a reconciliation sweep for impacted accounts.
- Owners: miguel (infra), support (customer outreach), finance (reconciliation), product (messaging)
```

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0315-01 resolved at 03:45 UTC — summary posted. Reaction: :white_check_mark: 

lee: nice work. moving to postmortem channel to assemble writeup. closing thread.
